topic: the 1919 Boston Molasses Flood that killed 21 people faster than they could run
title: A Wave Of Molasses Killed 21 People Faster Than They Could Run
description: In 1919 a molasses storage tank burst in Boston's North End and unleashed a wave fast enough to kill. This is AI-narrated historical commentary on how it happened and what came after. #shorts #history #boston

hook_candidates.text: Facts about the flood that killed 21 people in Boston, and it was made of molasses.
What moves 35 miles an hour, is sticky, and once killed 21 people in Boston?
A wave of molasses killing people sounds made up. It happened, and it outran anyone trying to run from it.
In 1919, a molasses tank in Boston burst without warning and unleashed a wave nobody could outrun.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who thinks they know every weird disaster in history, because they want to prove a flood of molasses actually outran people and killed them.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume any flood that killed 21 people in Boston must have been water, not molasses.
closing_comment: That molasses wave in Boston really did move faster than people could run, which is how it killed 21 of them.

beats.text: In 1919, a molasses tank in Boston's North End burst, releasing **2.3 million** gallons in minutes.
beats.broll_query: a massive steel tank rupturing open, thick brown liquid exploding outward across a city block

beats.text: Boston's sweetest smell turned deadly weather.

beats.text: The syrup was thick enough that victims **couldn't swim** free of it.
beats.broll_query: a person's arm reaching up from a thick pool of dark syrup, straining to break free

beats.text: Rescuers waded through waist-deep molasses for days, and trapped horses had to be **shot**.
beats.broll_query: rescue workers wading waist deep through dark syrup between wrecked buildings, exhausted expressions

beats.text: Nothing kills a sweet tooth faster.
beats.broll_query: an old fashioned dentist chair sitting abandoned in a flooded syrup covered street

beats.text: The company's first move was to blame **Italian anarchists** for a bomb.

beats.text: A six-year investigation found **no bomb**, just a tank built too thin for wartime demand.

beats.text: Some records still debate how much a sudden temperature swing mattered that day.
